rows.grounds: adverb of place indicating the rear position
adverb of place indicating the forward position
compound bhadra+dvaya; locative dual neuter referring to two auspicious positions
fused particle tu+evam; sandhi written as tvevaṃ
optative of samācar; prescriptive third-person singular active

items.question: How should one act with respect to the auspicious pair at back and front?
premises: The verse names back and front positions.
items.inference: One should perform the prescribed action for the auspicious pair at back and front.
uncertainties: The exact referent of bhadradvaye as sides or positions is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: At back and front, one should thus act with respect to the two auspicious positions.
